name: Category Manager for WooCommerce
author: allmassim

sections.description:
Category Manager for WooCommerce allows you to easily manage your WooCommerce product categories. Features include:
– Drag-and-drop reordering of categories
– Quick edit functionality to update category details
– Add new categories with name, slug, description, parent category, and image
– Seamless integration with WooCommerce

This plugin is perfect for store owners who need a more intuitive way to organize their product categories.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the category-manager-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Category Manager’ menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to start managing your categories.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with the latest version of WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin is tested and compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce.

Can I add images to categories?

Yes, you can upload an image for each category directly from the ‘Add New Category’ form.
